name: Free public buses in the Northern Territory
summary: All public bus services in Greater Darwin and Alice Springs are free, including for CDU students.
key: Travelling on all public bus services is currently free.
who: Anyone travelling on NT public buses in the Greater Darwin region or Alice Springs
catches: Free since 1 July 2025; the page gives no end date.

evidence.quote: Travelling on all public bus services is currently free.
All public bus services will continue to be free from 1 July 2025.
